messages:
marie: Heads-up — planning to roll out SDK v4 to hosted this Thursday 09:00 UTC. Need deploy owner, canary plan, smoke tests, and rollback readiness. Who can own the deploy window? :eyes:

 tj: I can take deploy ownership. I’ll run the canary and monitor metrics. Will do 2-stage canary: 1% then 20% for 15m each.

 priya: Thanks tj. Can you also validate backward compatibility with v3 clients? Any breaking surface we should call out to customers before the push?

 tj: Good call. I’ll run the compatibility suite and a few manual prompts. From infra side nothing changes in headers, but we added a new query param `sdk_version=4`. v3 should still work with old endpoints.

 alex: Confirming: SDK v4 introduces optional structured responses (JSON schema hints) and stricter type coercion for embeddings. No change to auth or routes. We'll add a compatibility flag for legacy clients if we see sign of regressions.

 sam: I'll prepare the client-comms draft and changelog entry. Plan: email and console banner 48h before, with migration guide and snippets. Also update release notes: short blurb + breaking-changes section (if any).

 marie: Good. tj — please paste the smoke test commands you want run so docs/SEs can follow. Also confirm rollback command and expected time-to-rollback.

 tj: Smoke tests (run after canary passes):
```
# health check
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sdk4/health | jq '.'
# simple generation (100 tokens)
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sdk4/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small-1","input":"Say hi","max_tokens":100}' | jq '.'
# SDK integration test (node)
node tests/smoke-sdk4.js
```
Rollback plan: if canary shows latency >200ms p50 regression or error-rate >0.5% sustained for 5m, revert to previous variant via deploy bot. Estimated rollback <6m once revert is triggered.

 deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window accepted by infra for 2025-04-03T09:00:00Z. Canary aliases: sdk4-canary-1, sdk4-canary-2. Auto-notify channel eng-releases on state changes.

 priya: Running compatibility checks now. Any specific test prompts I should include (edge cases)? I’ll add to the suite: long-context (>4k tokens), streaming responses, and function-calling payloads.

 alex: Add tests for KV cache reuse during `chat` sessions and header-based tenant isolation. Also test embeddings endpoint for subtle numeric diffs. Small numeric jitter is expected after quant changes — we should set alert thresholds accordingly.

 sam: Draft comms posted: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/sdk4-notice-draft.md — please review. I included upgrade snippets for Python/Node and a compatibility FAQ.

 marie: Great. final checklist: 1) deploy owner (tj) 2) comms published 48h prior (sam) 3) smoke scripts in repo (tj) 4) compatibility run complete (priya) 5) rollback verified (tj) 6) oncall aware (eng-oncall pinged)

 tj: I’ll post a short deploy playbook in this thread 1h before start and ping @eng-oncall during canary.

 priya: Compatibility suite ran — no blocking regressions in usual prompts. Noted slight embedding cosine shifts on model redwood-small-1-quant: delta ~0.006 for some vectors (within tolerance). Will add to release note.

 marie: Thanks team — I’ll mark this as the canonical rollout thread. If anything changes, update here. :shipit:
